data.text: Is the appliance installed in your primary residence?
data.help_text: Your primary residence is the home where you live most of the year.

data.text: Was the appliance installed between 2023 and 2032?
data.help_text: Only installations within this timeframe qualify for the tax credit.

data.text: Does the appliance meet ENERGY STAR specifications or exceed energy efficiency standards?
data.help_text: Check the appliance's specifications or manufacturer certification for efficiency ratings.

data.text: Did the manufacturer provide a Qualified Manufacturer Identification Number (QMID)?
data.help_text: Post-2025 installations must include a QMID provided by the manufacturer.

data.text: Can you verify the appliance's efficiency through documentation or certification?
data.help_text: Proper documentation is necessary to confirm eligibility for the tax credit.

data.text: Is the cost of the appliance and its installation less than the annual limit of $3,200, considering other credits claimed?
data.help_text: The credit is limited to a maximum of $3,200 annually.

data.text: Have you filed IRS Form 5695, Part II for the tax year of placement in service?
data.help_text: Filing Form 5695 is necessary to claim the residential energy credit.

data.title: Eligible for Full Tax Credit
data.summary: You qualify for a federal tax credit for your energy-efficient appliance purchase. Your appliance meets all criteria.

data.title: Not Eligible - Non-Primary Residence
data.summary: You are not eligible for the tax credit because the appliance is not installed in your primary residence.

data.title: Not Eligible - Installation Period
data.summary: Installation outside the eligible period (2023-2032) makes you ineligible.

data.title: Not Eligible - Efficiency Standards
data.summary: The appliance does not meet the required energy efficiency standards.

data.title: Not Eligible - QMID Missing
data.summary: Missing QMID for post-2025 installations disqualifies eligibility.

data.title: Not Eligible - Exceeds Credit Limit
data.summary: Total costs exceed the eligible annual credit limit.

data.title: Not Eligible - Lack of Documentation
data.summary: Inability to verify the appliance's qualifying efficiency through proper documentation.

data.title: Not Eligible - Failure to File Form 5695
data.summary: Filing the form is necessary for claiming the tax credit.
